pages.text: $(#8B0000)🔥 Ashen Rebirth · Everlasting Heartflame 🌺$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)「Drink the Phoenix’s tears, let embers reignite the spirit」$()$(br)As $(#4B0082)Charred Hibiscus$() blooms within $(#8B0000)Infernal Ember Dust$(), and $(#DAA520)Molten Honey$() wraps around the fiery core of $(#FF6347)Torch Flower$()—an ashen elixir is formed, capable of $(l)instant wound healing$() and $(l)rekindling the flame of life$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Dual Flame Restoration $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF0000)❤🔥 Heartflame Burst$()$(br)Wounds erupt with $(#FF4500)molten lava veins$(), instantly sealing themselves.$(br2)$(l)$(#CD5C5C)🛡 Ember Shield$()$(br)A $(#8B0000)floating ash membrane$() continuously restores durability.

$(br2)$(#2F4F4F)▌ Blazing Alchemy $()$(br)- Roast $(#4B0082)Hibiscus petals$() in $(#8B0000)Nether flames$() until they turn $(#CD3700)dark red, semi-charred$().$(br)- $(#FF6347)Torch Flower pollen$() must be melted with $(#DAA520)crystalized sugar$() into a $(#FF4500)amber gel$().$(br)- Stir the mixture vigorously using a $(#B22222)Obsidian Rod$(), counterclockwise, exactly $(#FF0000)seven times$() to prevent overheating.$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() A perfect brew will display $(#8B0000)Phoenix Wing patterns$().

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Legend of the Undying Bird 』$()$(br)A fragment from an ancient alchemist’s scroll:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#8B0000)Blazing Blood Elixir$(),$(br)shall endure the agony of $(#FF4500)Heartflame Ignition$() and witness the miracle of $(#CD5C5C)Ashen Rebirth$()—$(br)each $(#4B0082)Hibiscus petal$() carries the $(#FF6347)Phoenix$()’s $(#DAA520)contract of resurrection$(),$(br)and within $(#2F4F4F)embers$() shall forever remain the $(#FF0000)Seed of Life$().'
